disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Thaduberg is a techno-economic model. Every output is an estimate assembled from public benchmarks and your inputs — not investment, legal or regulatory advice. Benchmarks marked unverified have not been independently confirmed. Verify against primary sources before committing capital.

landing.heading: Green corridors, priced end to end.
landing.body: Thaduberg models the full cost of running a shipping corridor on green fuel versus fossil — production, vessels, ports and regulation — anchored to real project data, with a global hydrogen-cost map to site the plant. Sign in to open the platform, or request access below.
landing.requestSent: Almost there — check your inbox and confirm your email address to activate your account.
landing.forgotSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
landing.requestNote: Access is granted automatically once you confirm your email. Teaching and trial accounts are time-limited.
landing.errorSignIn: Sign-in failed — check your email and password.
landing.errorRequest: Could not create the account. If you already have one, sign in instead.
landing.errorForgot: Could not send the reset link. Try again in a moment.
landing.errorConfirmLink: That confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in, or request a new link.
landing.footnote: Estimates from public benchmarks and your inputs — not investment advice.

reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.error: Could not set the password — the link may have expired.
reset.expired: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

expired.heading: Your access has ended
expired.body: This trial or teaching account has reached the end of its access period. To keep working with the platform, get in touch and we can extend or upgrade the account.
expired.dataKept: Your saved scenarios are kept — they will all be there when access is restored.

admin.heading: User administration
admin.note: Access types: full (no limit), trial and teaching (time-limited — use +30 days to grant or extend). Expiring an account locks it out at the next request; saved scenarios are kept and restored on extension. Deleting a user permanently removes their account AND their saved scenarios.
admin.deleteConfirmBody: {email} will be permanently removed, together with all of their saved scenarios. This cannot be undone.
